newsitem.title: USA: Alliance Capital says not changing structure.
newsitem.headline: Alliance Capital says not changing structure.

text.p: Alliance Capital Management LP said Wednesday that will remain a publicly traded limited partnership because the Taxpayer Relief Act of 1997 was signed into law on Aug 5.
The company said in a statement that, now, it will not implement a previously announced change to a public corporate ownership structure.

Alliance Capital said it intends to use the option outlined in the Act, which it said allowed certain publicly traded partnerships to maintain partnership tax status, and pay an additional tax of 3.5 percent on partnership gross income.

Commenting on the new tax law, Dave Williams, chairman and chief executive officer of Alliance said, "We will avoid the cost of completing the conversion to a new type of publicly traded organization and our public unitholders will not suffer the major reduction in cash flow distribution which would have resulted had the partnership been taxed as a corporation."
